during the composition of PU from September 1818 to December 1819. In a letter to Hogg of
25 July 1819 (L ii 105), he mentions having read Aeschylus that Spring and tells Peacock on
24 August that he is considering translating some Gk plays (L ii 115); while on 20 April 1820
(L ii 186) he says that he is reading the Agamemnon with Lady Mountcashell (Mrs Mason).
